documents.title: THE K8 OBC Technical Data Sheet
documents.note: Kexcelled's own data sheet for THE K8 OBC, an olefin block copolymer filament: print guideline, material properties and printed-bar mechanical properties in three build directions.

documents.title: Hemp PLA Technical Data Sheet
documents.note: Filamentive's own data sheet for Hemp PLA: its composition and eleven properties with their test methods.

documents.title: Hemp Based PLA – Sustainable 3D Printing Filament - 1.75mm, 1 kg - Filamentive
documents.note: Filamentive's own store page for Hemp PLA: its print recipe (printing temperature, bed temperature, no hardened nozzle needed) and its 1.75 mm diameter, which its data sheet does not print.

documents.title: QIDI PPS-GF20 3D printer filament (QIDI store)
documents.note: QIDI's own store page for PPS-GF20: its glass load, a property table, its recommended print settings, drying and cautions.

documents.title: Ultrafuse PP GF30 Technical Data Sheet
documents.note: Forward AM's own data sheet for Ultrafuse PP GF30: its print recipe and drying, and printed-bar mechanical, impact and thermal tables (pages 3 to 5 are images).

documents.title: PA-NT Technical Data Sheet
documents.note: Sakata 3D's own data sheet for PA-NT, an unfilled copolyamide: physical, mechanical and thermal properties and its print settings.

documents.title: PA-CF15 Technical Data Sheet
documents.note: Sakata 3D's own data sheet for PA-CF15, a copolyamide with 15 % carbon fibre: properties (mechanical values dry as moulded) and its print settings.

documents.title: Technical Data Sheet ASA (AzureFilm, 05.24)
documents.note: AzureFilm's own data sheet for ASA, served from its own site: printed-bar properties at 100 % infill in three build directions and its print recommendations. The sheet held for the product (R-3DJAKE-3DJAKE-ASA-TDS-1, hosted by 3DJake) prints other test settings; both stay.

documents.title: ASA filament Blue (AzureFilm)
documents.note: AzureFilm's own product page for ASA: "This material can be printed without an enclosed printer but we strongly recommend using an enclosure".

documents.title: ASA Prusament is here: learn everything about the successor to ABS (Prusa blog)
documents.note: Prusa Research's own launch article for Prusament ASA, which recommends printing it inside an enclosure.

documents.title: LUVOCOM 3F (LEHVOSS brochure, German)
documents.note: LEHVOSS's own LUVOCOM 3F brochure; read for its statement on LUVOCOM 3F PPS CF 9938 BK: "Unser Material braucht keinen temperierten Bauraum für den Druckvorgang."

documents.title: Raise3D Fiber Reinforced Technology white paper v2.0
documents.note: Raise3D's own white paper on its fibre-reinforced filaments: PA12 CF's properties as printed and annealed at 100 °C, and that the RMF 500 prints it warp-free without the heating chamber.

documents.title: PolyMide PA12-CF Product Information Sheet
documents.note: Polymaker's own product information sheet for PolyMide PA12-CF: its print settings with a chamber of 25-50 °C, drying "if the filament has absorbed moisture", and its properties as printed beside annealed.

documents.title: Carbon Fiber PLA (Eryone)
documents.note: Eryone's own product page for its carbon-fibre PLA: "Carbon Fiber Content: 15%" and its print settings.

documents.title: ePLA-CF Filament safety data sheet
documents.note: eSUN's own safety data sheet for ePLA-CF, as the Wayback Machine captured it (2025-08-13); read for the carbon-fibre load its composition section states.

documents.title: TECHNICAL DATA SHEET Fiberlogy R PP (2025)
documents.note: Fiberlogy's own current data sheet for R PP, served from its own site and linked from its product page: a later revision of R-FIBERLOGY-FIBERLOGY-R-PP-TDS (OPEN-PROBLEMS §39.1). Its heat deflection of 40 °C is labelled 1.8 MPa here, where the product page labels it 0.45 MPa (F-0680).

documents.title: Essentium PA-CF safety data sheet
documents.note: Essentium's own safety data sheet for PA-CF, as Filament2Print serves it: section 3 names the polymer "Polyamide (PA 6/66)", which files the product under PA6/66-CF (m490).

documents.title: Panchroma Matte PLA (Polymaker wholesale store)
documents.note: Polymaker's own store page for Panchroma Matte PLA, which names its former product name: "PolyTerra PLA" (F-0678).

OBC.composition: "Olefin Block Copolymers" (Chemical name, p. 1, as the sheet states it)

HEMP.composition: "90% plant-based PLA and 10% hemp byproducts" (p. 1, as the sheet states it)

PPSGF.composition: Polyphenylene sulfide with "20% glass fiber" (the maker's store page, as it states it)

PPGF.composition: Polypropylene with "30% glass fiber" (p. 3, as the sheet states it)

PANT.composition: "unfilled copolyamide (Nylon)" (p. 1, as the sheet states it); the maker names no polyamide

PACF15.composition: "copolyamide" with "15% carbon fiber" (p. 1, as the sheet states it); the maker names no polyamide
